protocol.image_score: maximum of the 21x21 smoothed anomaly map
protocol.inference_measurement: Engine.predict wall time divided by test image count; batch 1; no visualizer
protocol.preprocessing: RGB [0,1], bilinear antialiased resize, no normalization
protocol.runtime_measurement: full 300-epoch fit including per-epoch test evaluation
protocol.selection: independent image and raw-pixel maxima; later ties replace earlier epochs
protocol.selection_split: complete MVTec test split after each epoch
protocol.selection_warning: Test-oracle selection; not an unbiased generalization estimate.
protocol.training_geometry: 128x128 tiles, stride 64, independent rotations in [-90,90] degrees
